# Folio Portfolio
> Single-page portfolio for Divinne Amunega, Nigerian fullstack developer (Lagos-based) building fast, secure web apps with Astro + React + Tailwind CSS, GSAP animations, Vercel Analytics.

Hero with profile (/person.jpg), "Fullstack Developer" title, "Based in Lagos, Nigeria" badge, stats (10+ Projects, Fullstack, Available), "Get in touch" CTA (mailto:divineamunega@gmail.com).
